subject: Startups
title: AI's Impact on VC
description: A quick win: understand AI's Impact on VC.

hook.text: AI is changing how VCs find deals, evaluate startups, and even predict which companies will succeed.

buildup.text: Some firms use AI to scan thousands of data points: hiring patterns, web traffic, patent filings, and social signals.

discovery.text: SignalFire built a data platform tracking 6 million companies in real time to spot promising startups early.

twist.text: But the best deals still come from human relationships. AI can source leads, but trust closes deals.

climax.text: AI won't replace VCs. It'll make the data-savvy ones faster and help them find founders they'd otherwise miss.

punchline.text: AI finds the signal. Humans still make the judgment call.

quiz.question: How are some VC firms using AI?
options: To scan data and identify promising startups early
